name: Viso del Marqués (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally light blue over yellow with a white triangle issuing from the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Viso del Marqués (a chequy field on red).
history: Municipal flag of Viso del Marqués; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
Viso del Marqués arms — chequy on red
